description.en: Re-encode PNG and JPEG as WebP before they enter the conversation.
description.zh-CN: 图片进入对话前把 PNG、JPEG 重新编码为 WebP。

description.en: Replace images from earlier turns with a text placeholder, so they are not uploaded again.
description.zh-CN: 把更早轮次中的图片替换为文字占位符，之后不再重复上传。

description.en: Ask the model for a one-line description before the pixels are dropped.
description.zh-CN: 丢弃像素前让模型写一行描述。

description.en: How many recent turns keep their images in full.
description.zh-CN: 最近多少轮对话保留完整图片。

description.en: Cap on messages with images, even inside a kept turn. 0 leaves no cap.
description.zh-CN: 限制带图片的消息数量，同一轮内也生效；0 表示不限制。

description.en: Ceiling for the longer side when an image is re-encoded.
description.zh-CN: 重新编码时图片长边的上限。

description.en: 0 saves the most bandwidth, 100 keeps the most detail.
description.zh-CN: 0 最省流量，100 保留最多细节。

description.en: Fall back to a bare path when a description takes longer. 0 waits without a limit.
description.zh-CN: 生成描述超过这个时间就只写路径；0 表示不限时。
